topic.para: The following sections describe the &ssg; profiles for &productnameshort; 16 and how to scan a system against them with oscap. They then explain how to adapt a profile with a tailoring file and how to remediate the system with the adapted profile.
The examples in this article use the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) profile.
